plus_code.compound_code: 5M44+JG Taiwan, 台中市西屯區何南里

reviews.text:
Love the cozy setup, warm hospitality and food preparation. Restaurant deco gives off a zen vibe.

Each dish is curated and prepared in high level of quality; and beautifully plated. The doneness of the lamb at 30% is exquisite and succulent.

Wine pairing is quite spot on; with a bold mix of sake as well.

Overall, an enjoyable experience.

A lovely fine dining restaurant in Taichung.
Very beautiful interior with amazing service and of course the exceptional menu.
It was a very enjoyable experience as I had never tried fine dining, the staff were very accommodating and would explain each dish and wine/kombucha pairing in detail. The new seasonal menu was very unique.
Overall a very lovely experience that I wish to share with others when the new menu comes out.

Went for a birthday dinner. It is a  9 courses tasting menu, plus snacks, brioche. I was stuffed and feeling impressed by the great food and excellent service.

What truly stood out to me was Chef Ricky's brilliant use of Asian and Taiwan local ingredients, skillfully fused into each dish. From the Penghu seaweed brioche to the locally sourced red shrimp and Dong Quan Chili Sauce, every combination was a pleasant surprise, resulting in an exquisite blend of flavors.

I also choose the non-alcohol pairing which is the house brewed Kombucha. The FIRNS team using a variety of fruits and ingredients to brew the kombucha. When pairing with food, it created a new experience that I haven't found in elsewhere. Really suggest adding this option.

The price is very reasonable. Given the stunning food and seamless service I have . It is really worth for the money. I can confidently say that the entire dining experience was nothing short of remarkable. Absolutely will recommend to my friends! I am already looking forward for next chapter of the menu.

An unforgettable experience. We arrived at 6pm and the next 3 hours and the 13 courses were simply delicious entertainment. Price is absolutely fine for what you are presented with. Pairing comes either with wine (a natural wine selection, which was something new) or home made kombucha. The attentive staff explains every course carefully (English as well) and the chef seems to have been in the best restaurants around the world. His experience and ingredients blend well into the menu. I can warmly recommend this (still) secretive spot in Taichung.
The food, service and ambience was amazing! Every dish was spectacular. The flavor, quality and plating were all top notch. Perfect place to experience the delicacy of fusion cuisines.

FIRNS.vicinity: No. 19號, Lane 50, Jingcheng Road, Xitun District

editorial_summary.overview: Tranquil fine-dining destination plating avant-garde delicacies featuring local ingredients.

\u6f80 Sur-.formatted_address: 400, Taiwan, Taichung City, Central District, Zhongshan Rd, 29號3樓
\u6f80 Sur-.name: 澀 Sur-

plus_code.compound_code: 4MQM+38 Taiwan, 台中市中區綠川里

reviews.text:
Modern, elevated interpretation of traditional Taiwanese cuisine. Thoughtful use of local ingredients that showcases the flavors and quality.

The space is set in a preserved historical building. The server explained the concept behind the decor and the restaurant’s objective to create a comfortable space.

😋 The dishes are full of innovation and fun details. Most importantly, they taste delicious and you will be full by the end of the meal (don’t be deceived by the small portions 😂).

🍷 Interesting wine pairing and we appreciate the flexibility of the sommelier in accommodating our preferences. It would have been great to have a wider wine list (for ordering by the bottle), but I understand the restaurant’s desire to create a curated experience where they can control the pairing.

Overall an enjoyable fine dining restaurant that I would recommend. The house made fortune cookies was a fun touch to wrap up the meal 🥠

If you are familiar with Taiwanese cuisine, the meal will be particularly resonating - it certainly plucked at my heartstrings.

I didn’t set any expectations before visit Sur, but its services and food quality really made up good dining experiences. I was impressed by the non-alcoholic mocktail pairing where it’s gave me another level of understanding of Taiwanese teas. My favorite non-alcoholic drink of the night was 3rd drink - Jinxuan tea mixed with white gourd,bergamot and orange blossom. As for food, I would recommend the Spring roll, and Goose dish 😋.

Sur is undoubtedly my top three favorite restaurants in Taichung. I’ve been dining at Sur ever since their soft opening couple years ago and the menu has really gone through a huge evolution. There is always so much excitement into discovering a new ingredient that I’ve never eaten before..not to mention very out of the blue combinations that just turns out amazing! The Chef puts in so much hard work and effort in creating new dishes that I’ve been coming back every season to try what’s new. I’m really in awe in his effort to educate his customers about the culture of Taichung (through new immigrant flavor), sustainability, and what type of food to each during each season.

I highly recommend Sur!

This is a Taiwanese cuisine with some creative thinking. The chef does work hard to present the creative ideas. However, it’s still a long way to go for further improvement. It’s supposed to be 4 stars, but without wine pairing so losing one star. Good food should be paired with suitable wines. All the names of plates are with typical Taiwanese familiar dishes. If it was opened in Taipei, it might have attracted more customers with the current price range.

A cozy and beautiful space with a creative prix fixe menu and both alcoholic and non-alcoholic pairing options. A lot of elements of local culture and ingredients are incorporated in the food and drink which makes it almost a little nostalgic. Everything was good and the presentation was beautiful. The staff is super friendly as well.

\u6f80 Sur-.vicinity: 3樓, No. 29號, Zhongshan Road, Central District

Smokey Joe\u2019s.name: Smokey Joe’s

plus_code.compound_code: 4MR8+PM Taiwan, 台中市西區安龍里

reviews.text: Nice ambience and friendly staff. But dining time is an issue. Before we finish our meal they are rushing to close and start sweeping the floor. Nevertheless, the varieties of food is wide and has many choices. Some recipe is concocted and may not be the truly traditional European recipe. Overall quite enjoyable meal.

We searched online for a notable place to dine at Taichung and Smokey Joes pop out.
When we first entered the restaurant, the service was sharp and swift, however, once we sat at our table for ordering then came the issues.

We were quickly rushed to order and i understand that it was supposedly to be the last order but we adhere to the limitations they presented to us (of ordering before 8pm). But the waitress assigned to us kept pestering us and even standing at the table side awaiting our order even though we werent ready, which I think its pretty rude. We also informed her that we would like all onions and parsley to not be mixed into the dishes due to my girlfriend’s dietary restrictions, but she somehow seemed confused by the request.

We ordered the corn soup with shrimp, potato and cheese, pulled pork sliders, chicken fajita, squid spaghetti.

The corn soup with shrimp and potato & cheese was pretty good. The pulled pork sliders also delivered its flavors however the coleslaw (which came full of onions) that came together was honestly disgusting. The fajita still had parsley sprinkled on top of it, the chicken was good just that the fact that parsley was still added onto it was negligent. THE SQUID INK SPAGHETTI WAS SO BAD. We couldn’t even finish it. There was no taste whatsoever and the squid was way too salty.

We were given 90mins to dine but the staff also started clearing everything and cleaning up near our table while we were still dining which was not professional at all. Overall, the dining experience was disappointing.

With such a diverse food scene that Taichung has to offer, Smokey Joe’s definitely tops the list of must have visits!

The staff was so friendly and welcoming and the menu choice offered lots of variety from vegetarian to amazing gourmet burgers!

As a returning customer, I can’t wait to visit you guys again soon! Thanks for your service! ☺️
One of the best Tex-Mex restaurant in Taiwan!!!

Simply amazing decor. Food was great. The mozzarella burger was great and filling. The iced coffee, while expensive, was delicious. Chocolate cake was amazing, and the sea salt accentuates the dark chocolate. All in all, this is now one of, if not my favorite, restaurant in Taichung. Also, a great place if you have kids.

forchetta.name: forchetta

plus_code.compound_code: 5J6R+CV Taiwan, 台中市西屯區惠來里

reviews.text: 2nd visit here and satisfaction achieved once again. Chef lets the local ingredients shine instead of masking with heavy seasoning and that’s the joy of having Mediterranean style food. Friendly service. Will certainly return!

Forchetta Restaurant is a hidden gem in the heart of Taichung, where culinary mastery meets a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

The charming decor and attentive staff create the perfect backdrop for a delightful dining experience.

The menu is a symphony of flavours, local produce, creative cooking and great taste.

Definitely room for improvement considering the great selection of restaurants in Taiwan.

Absolutely amazing fine dining restaurant. The decoration is cozy, relaxing and beautiful. We are here for lunch, and the price is between 2k to 3k TWD, which is reasonable price fir fine dining.

Water is served by bottle, choosing from sparkling to plain. My wife chooses Iberico pork, and I got the Australian wagyu steak, amazing.

The food ingredients are mostly sourcing locally, which is a great support for Taiwanese fine dining restaurant. Love it, will visit again!

It’s an amazing dinner, my friends and I enjoyed a lot. The chef use a lot local ingredients and each meal has its own flavor. We ordered steak for main course, the beef is tender but not too raw. A little pricey but worth the money.

Forchetta is one of few restaurants with 1 Michelin Star in Taichung and they are famous for their Omakase style menu by using seasonal ingredients. Reservation is needed and I highly recommend to make it in advance.

Street parking is available and it is located on the 2nd floor. The interior is elegant and cozy with an industrial ceiling and vintage decoration. There were only 5 options for entrees on the menu, but the staff asked everyone’s allergy & restriction in details.

The course started with 4 appetizers (5 for dinner) which varied every day, continued with an entree, and finished with 2 desserts & tea. Our favorite appetizer was the mushroom with mashed potato, which was a great balance between juicy & creamy.

Our entrees were Rib Eye Steak & Iberian Pork and we preferred the pork, which was soft & satisfying. Both desserts were decent and we loved the Truffle Burrata Pudding. The chef would serve a sugar-built tower which is photo-worthy if customers celebrate their special occasions there.

It was a great & pleasant dining experience at a reasonable & affordable price that we would highly recommend people to give it try.

forchetta.vicinity: 2樓, No. 15號, Huizhong 6th Street, Xitun District

Exceeded my expectations. Wasn’t expecting a lot from a cafe in bookstore. The tea with guava is very refreshing, and the cake is also quite good.
The environment is clean and beautiful, staff helpful and professional. Great teas!! Beautiful gift box options too.

Walked in without reservation and managed to get a table for 2 on a Saturday, 5.30pm. Shortly after we were seated, the place was almost filled up.

The ambience here is really warm, cozy and the service here is excellent.

Though it's full, but the tables were well spaced out. 👍Being a tourist, they proactively recommended us some dishes and were really patient with going through the menu with us. Thankful for the friendy staff. 👍

The food and the food presentation is really good. Insta worthy. 😍

Pretty fancy place to have tea and dessert. I ordered chicken soup too. The tea was very decent and quenching but the recommended green bean cake was not as impressive. The chicken soup was good but everything here was a bit over-priced. Came with some friends otherwise I probably would not have come.

reviews.text:
All the dumplings are nice and juicy. Shrimp pork were the highlight. The ones with soup inside them are all good.

Sticky pepper pork rice is pretty good, but definitely tastes like a Fastfood Version. If you had a good one from a market, you know what I mean.

Curry soup is kind of a cafeteria concept. It's not bad, just a fun soup for kids I guess.

To summarise, come for the dumplings.
Excellent Shanghai steam bun and fried bun! Very juicy, so becareful when you bite into it. The clear noodle soul is a best combo to go with the buns.
The restaurant famous for the dumplings. We ordered 2 kinds of the dumplings, pork and leek/veggie. Both of them are really tasty and flavorful.
The taste is decent but a bit pricy ($90 for 5 pan-fried buns)

Simply amazing! One of the best pan fried buns (生煎包) I've had. Super juicy and super crunchy. Their steamed dumplings are good too. Their curry soup looks mild but actually packs quite a punch! Not the spicy kind but definitely flavorful. Price is slightly high if you compare with streetside pushcarts, but definitely reasonable for a restaurant. I would prefer them over the more famous Ding Tai Feng. More homely and less oily as compared to the more commercialized latter

editorial_summary.overview: Upscale restaurant presenting innovative Singaporean cuisine amid understated surroundings.

JL STUDIO.formatted_address: 408, Taiwan, Taichung City, Nantun District, Yifeng Rd. Sec.4, 689號2樓
JL STUDIO.name: JL STUDIO

plus_code.compound_code: 5J2H+5C Taiwan, 台中市南屯區新生里

reviews.text:
Modern Singaporean cuisine that incorporates local ingredients to reinterpret traditional dishes.

Haven’t had such a fun fine-dining experience in a long while. I am thoroughly impressed by the innovative dishes and thoughtful service.

📍Located on the second floor of a building shared with another restaurant. You will need to wait at the reception and the staff will come pick you up near your reservation time. The decor is minimalistic with lots of wooden tones and soft natural lighting.

⏰ The 9+ course meal took about 3 hours.

✨ The entire service team was super attentive and welcoming. Special shout out to the sommelier - she did a phenomenal job explaining the wines in a relatable manner, making the meal more enjoyable.

😋 Every dish was so creative in terms of flavors and presentation. It was a sensory delight!

💭 My only wish was for the wine pairing to have more glasses 🤣

Worth the hype and so happy that we were finally able to give it a try 🙏 I love the thoughtfulness - you can tell that the team invested a lot of effort into curating the experience and everything is executed with intent.

Had to try this restaurant for several reasons, first it has become a Michelin 3 stars restaurant and also wanting to try Singaporean cuisine overseas and supporting a Singaporean chef.
Visited the restaurant and it's in a building with another restaurant. Enter the building entrance and the staff will guide you to walk past the other restaurant dining area to get to a lift to the 2nd floor.
Once seated, was shown the menu and asked for allergies before dinner commenced. The staff spoke English but I replied them back in Chinese which made them more friendly and at ease.
Basically the meal was very good, nothing much to fault about. The way the chef planned for Singaporean cuisine to be defined in such a creative way is remarkable.  You won't be able to believe the dish when you see it and have to taste it to get back the flavours of the dish.
Few thoughts on the dishes throughout the meal:
1. The black hor fun was good. It's like the hor fun was presented in an Italian way.
2. Using fish as chicken rice was certainly creative, but something was just amiss without the rice.
3. Nasi lemak using squid was super creative. I really liked the idea and the nasi lemak has transformed to another level.
4. The curry ice cream was really quite unbelievable and exceptionally good. How I wished I could ask for more.
5. The rojak palette cleanser was also quite mind blowing. So few elements on the plate but could bring out the flavours of the entire dish.
6. Was surprised by the taste of the Chinese mugwort Ambon. Sounded scary wondering if it would taste herbal but was so well executed.
Great experience dining here and definitely on the 'must try' list in Taichung. Definitely worth the stars accolade.

This is the highlight of our holiday trip - a Michelin 3 star restaurant led by Singaporean Jimmy Lin, serving Singaporean cuisine. Kudos to Jimmy Lin for doing Singapore proud!

The food was creative and visually appealing. The presentation was very different from the original Singaporean dish, but tasted exactly like the original.

Unfortunately, they recently changed the menu, would have loved to taste his famous rendition of chicken rice and ba kut teh, which are the more well known dishes for the international audience. Will be hard to explain what assam fish and mee rubus is to them.

Nic does an excellent job in leading the wait staff and patiently explaining each dish's relevance to the original and the ingredients used.

Had a great time as a Singaporean! The flavours are very authentic and pays a stellar tribute to the dishes I grew up enjoying. 🙌🏼 Definitely worth a visit!

Special shout out to Roy who made an amazing service recovery for one of the dish and even gave us some local recommendations. Roy is very friendly and personable, making the entire dinner very pleasant. ⭐️⭐️⭐️ 3 stars well-deserved for the restaurant and Roy.

I was expecting a wow experience, we got a so-so one. The food is nothing special. Of course very well cooked, top ingredients, but we are in a 3-stars Michelin, this should not be questioned. Where is the special kick? Everything is ordinary, the beef with a pineapple ball and a beef juice on it. Please. The worst 8.000$ spent on a Michelin star restaurant. 3 stars... Unbelievable. The staff is undertrained, they neither knew the origin of the ingredients. The location? You've to pass by another restaurant and the washing room. The chef? Neither come out to say hello to his guests. To avoid.

JL STUDIO.vicinity: 2樓, No. 689號, Yifeng Road Section 4, Nantun District

reviews.text:
Finally visited the original boba milk tea place in Taiwan!
The location is in Taichung.

The place is comfortable and clean, easy to find and access.
The boba milk tea is delicious, with just the right sweetness and a light, refreshing taste. 🧋🧋🧋

For other food, I tried the noodles, and they were absolutely delicious. 🍜🍜
The service is very fast and friendly.

If you're looking for boba milk tea, this place is highly recommended! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

I stop by this place because most people who visit Taichung recommend it. When I come, there was many people queue up for order and reserve the table. I waited around one hour to get in and order. I tried the original bubble tea, it was really good. The taste wasn't overly sweet and the bobba is very soft. The vegetarian dried noodle was also delicious. Although its a bit pricey, i think worth every penny! Good visit when in Taichung...

I was lucky that there was not much of a queue and we got our seats in 5mins.
The fried carrot cake was so good. We also tried the vegetarian noodles, braised eggs, garlic toast and Fuzhou balls. It was all very decent. The bubble/boba milk tea was nice. The ambience was pleasant too. A good worthy visit.

Tried again the World's first bubble tea -  "Origin of Pearl Milk Tea" The food menu offered a delightful variety of Taiwanese dishes. I tried the braised pork rice and beef noodle soup—both hearty and flavorful.

We went right before dinner time, so we skipped the crowd. The milk tea is of course, good, but wouldn’t say I’d go here again just for that. Their wontons are very very good. And their toilet is wonderful! Just that there’s only one stall.

plus_code.compound_code: 5J4R+MR Taiwan, 台中市西屯區惠來里

reviews.text: Great time to celebrate my wedding anniversary with my wife and kids in this restaurant. All the staffs showed good caring with our celebration (this is our first visit of this place). Food was delicious and nothing to complain.

The ambiance was really nice. Steak is cooked really well and you get that melt-in-your-mouth texture. Highly recommend the Dry-aged rib eye. Staff were really attentive and accommodating. Definitely not cheap but worth it.

Truly five star services that fulfill your special requests to achieve those special occasions. The set dinner is always to the taste buds standard, and the kitchen offers variety per seasons' greetings. The window view is another selling point of the restaurant. Great wine cellar to celebrate with your friends too. Basement parking available.

This place is better than I thought!
Dozens of choices with lower price lunch menus to higher quality steaks!
But apparently there are more appetizer, soup and dessert choices according to staff.
Various sauces to accompany your steak.
Table service is extremely nice and friendly.
But beware both the water/sparkling water are additional charges.

Steak is real great, but wanted medium rare for them. However it’s lost its pink when I cut through the middle. More like a 7 or well done to me.
Asked the staff to double check with chef, still got back the answer of medium rare and not overdone.
The head chef came out to provide business card, but only handed one out to my family member and not me. Not sure if he’s only giving per table or lack of respect.
Ordered 2 sets from different price range, besides our coffee latte, everything else was exceptional. Service is top notch. I've had stakes all around the world, I'd say this place is in my top list.

Night School Braised Pork Rice.formatted_address: No. 109, Jingcheng Rd, West District, Taichung City, Taiwan 403
Night School Braised Pork Rice.name: Night School Braised Pork Rice

plus_code.compound_code: 5M24+53 Taiwan, 台中市西區公德里

reviews.text:
Had to pay this place a visit because it's in the Michelin Bib Gourmand list. Have tried quite a number of Braised Pork rice in taiwan and had my likes and dislikes, had to come here judge for myself because it's in the list.
Place was rather crowded even at 9pm, wonder if the locals don't have their dinner early. I liked how systematic and efficient the queuing and management of crowd was, you take an order slip with colour based on whether you are dining in or takeaway. Then inform the staff the number of persons and then they will source a seat for the group. Once the seat is confirmed, you will be asked to head to payment counter and food order will be processed.
Very smooth and food was prepared rather quickly and the moment they call your receipt number just raise your hand and the staff will bring the food to the table.
So funny the staff actually apologized to me for giving me double portion of the tofu I ordered.
First, I had high expectations and it kinda fell short. I had the braised pork rice and I felt that the flavours were not what I expected it to be. The taste was milder compared to typical ones though the meat was tenderly braised. Somehow they seemed to make use of the preserved vegetables to make up for the flavours so as not to make the dish taste too salty. I liked the preserved vegetables and they were good but would have preferred the gravy to have a stronger taste.
The highlight for me was the braised tofu. The braised tofu was so soft, you can still take it with chopsticks without breaking and yet it felt like melting in the mouth.
The egg was also perfectly cooked and i strongly recommend putting the egg on the rice and break the yolk and let the lava flow onto the rice and not just chug the egg into the mouth directly.
The pigs blood soup was light and simple, but the pig's blood was so delicious felt it was to die for.
As it is a braised pork rice shop, I felt it could have been better, but I felt that the sides have actually saved the day.
Worth giving a try to find out yourself, but maybe just lower the expectations a little.
best braised pork rice i have had!! all the other dishes are great too. melt in the mouth. the queue is super long though.

Decent mass cooked food for supper. Famous pork rice is under braised & dry. Pork leg is good. The braised sauce is not the heavy spices type. More soya type. Decent price. The place is super hot tho.

Came here and not queue. The owner and staffs are very welcome to me. They help and give me some recommend food, they also asked me about the food tastes, its good or not, and ask me if I want to order more, he can help me to order it. Thank you so much sir ! You are so heartwarming to me 💙

The shop provides clear instructions for dine in. Worth trying food : 豬腳飯，排骨，苦瓜湯. The soup was really surprising. Feels slightly rush to dine in, because alot people waiting for a table due to the limited space.

editorial_summary.overview: Trendy choice with a set menu spotlighting reimagined French cuisine, plus coffee & wine.

PI RESTAURANT.name: PI RESTAURANT

plus_code.compound_code: 4MX2+PF Taiwan, 台中市南屯區大業里

reviews.text:
Can't really find anything I don't like about the food. It's nice fine dining with a mix of French and local delicacies. Every dish comes with small edible flower petals. I like the pork with kimchi dish in particular.

The restaurant is roomy and comfortable. Will visit again.

My husband and I went here to celebrate our wedding anniversary. The food quality was absolutely amazing with rich and perfectly balanced flavor. Furthermore, their professional explanation of each menu made us taste even better for savory foods & wine. And their English was perfect! We really enjoyed our time in this restaurant😀

Amazing new restaurant that serves a very refreshing fusion of european and asian cuisines. The grilled mushrooms were packed full of umami flavors and the egg yolk and cream sauce were a great compliment. The chicken skewers were very reminiscent of japanese yakitori. The accompanying chicken fat aioli with salmon roe really was a nice twist to a very well known dish. Best dish we had was probably the spinach ravioli. Cooked al dente which you sadly dont find enough in taichung. Steak was a bit too well done for my taste but great accompanying sauce. Desert was great, caramel tart with coconut ice cream. Perfect balance and savory and sweet really made the dish stand out. They dont make many so you need to place an order fast. So happy to see a restaurant like this in Taichung.

Pi (pronounce like Pie) Restaurant and coffee is new to the neighborhood, chef Pi is a young, passionate and lovely guy, he opened this new project with a team of food lovers/young chefs. The menu was quite ambitious but prices are friendly. It’s a casual dining place with a nice flair, food is genuine and wine list is decent.

Will have to try the coffee next time :)

There were moments of brilliant execution in the crisp fish skin, the smoky char of the vegetables, and the goji berry ice cream. The plating was really well done, as you can see. However the chefs are still looking for their unique voice and need more finesse or familiarity with the ingredients. The service was really great and attentive. Promising restaurant. Jia you!

Banana Leaf.formatted_address: No. 138號, Wenxin South 7th Rd, Nantun District, Taichung City, Taiwan 408
Banana Leaf.name: Banana Leaf

plus_code.compound_code: 4JHX+VP Taiwan, 台中市南屯區豐樂里

reviews.text: The food is close to authentic and well-made. In some restaurants, there are only certain foods that are more authentic, but the quality and authenticity of the food is even throughout, and all taste good. Worth a trip here! The staff are also very attentive and patient (I dropped my egg and the staff swiftly mopped it away, thank you!). At the time of this review, they also have an outlet at Yunlin.

I think this is more like a Taiwanese-Malaysian dishes which the food has been adjusted into Taiwanese likings. But overall the food was nice, the service was okay (no complaints), and overall the place is nice for gatherings.

After a trip to Penang earlier this year, I've been missing the depth of flavors that good Malaysian cuisine provides. This place brought me right back and did not disappoint.

We ordered 5 dishes; all of which were delicious in their own right. The Beef Martabak, however, stole the show. The combination of succulent and crispy textures along with the rich flavors made every mouthful an indulgent experience. It exceeded any expectations.

Because the satay(480nt) and char kway teow (300nt) are basic street food items that are sold for about 10% of the price in Malaysia, it's hard to give out a full 5 stars. However, if you are craving proper Malaysian food, it's definitely worth a visit.

Atmosphere and service were both great.

(edited)
been to this restaurant countless time and even recommend it to a lot of friends, but this last visit I am super disappointed! The Penang seafood char kuey teow that used to be super super good, today I got rotten/overcooked calamari inside that is not bite-able at all!  The price is increased tho!
Drinks wise, the price is decreased but you cannot find the old authentic Malaysian Milo Dinosaur as before! It just become tasteless and sweet-less. Dunno maybe the boss has changed when the menu book is changed too? 🤔

(original)
Probably the best Malaysian restaurant in Taichung! I like the Penang Char Kuey Teow, so flavorful and well seasoned. Nasi lemak beef rendang is also a special dish for me, beef rendang came out with a very large portion, made it worth the price!

The place was cozy and clean, the service was also friendly and fast
The food was quite authentic, the curry was great
But they didn't have any english menu, and the portion was just okay, not too big
Also, the price can be quite expensive, but still reasonable

reviews.text: An example of excellence in Taiwanese cuisine and design. Everything is made to perfection from the tea to the main courses and the desserts. The environment is beautiful and curated in every detail. Recently got awarded with one well deserved Michelin star. Worth a trip to Taichung to try it.

Structured flavors, elegant serving dishes and staff elevates what is usually the humble, accessible Taiwanese cuisine.  The tea pairing is aromatic and flavorful.  Convenient location near the highway for a meal for travelers

I absolutely loved it here. Came for lunch alone without a reservation. The fit me in no problem. Food was fantastic. The service was wonderful and everyone was so nice. The sommelier was fantastic. She recommended a wine not on the menu and I loved it. I felt like I was hanging out with friends even though I was alone . Thankyou!

Excellent experience doing the set tasting menu. The portions were more than generous and the service was top notch. It was great experiencing the traditional Taiwanese cuisine with an elevated approach.

We came here for tasting menu.
This place def has potential to get stars.
Hopefully next time we come back to Taiwan we will see this already !
Well done ❤️

reviews.text: Very cozy and friendly bar n restaurant. They created a comfortable environment for enjoying the food and music. The shop is small but full of surprises. The menu is short, but everything is so good. From appetisers, to main, desserts, cocktails and non-alcohol. The spicy chicken risotto is really good.  Non-alcohol I recommend smokey gourd tea. The pudding is unpredictable. Support and applause to the young owners and team. You guys are on the right path, cozy and chill little bar with really flavoured menu, topped with great taste of music.

Delicious fries, and amazing pasta with a spicy kick to it.
Wonderful atmosphere and great service~

The service attitude of the staff is very good, and the chicken wings and pudding are delicious! ! I chatted with friends for more than 2 hours and they didn’t rush us (it wasn’t full at the time). It’s a store with 100% experience.
The pudding is very hard. It’s the first time I’ve tasted this texture, but it’s delicious (,, -᷅ ̫̈-᷄ ,,)
Will definitely return for a return visit! !
I think it’s very considerate to be able to adjust the bartending if it doesn’t suit your taste. I’m also in the service industry. It’s rare to have such a good dining experience. Thank you to the store owner for their thoughtfulness.

There was a customer leaving the store, and I was lucky enough to be able to enter.
A stylish bar both inside and out.

The highball was made quite strong, but it's irresistible for alcohol lovers and is the best ◎
The lime on top is also stylish!

Not only the alcohol but also the food was all delicious! The stir-fried zucchini and mushrooms is a little tangy, but the flavor is absorbed into the ingredients, making it the perfect snack to go with alcohol.
Perhaps because the pasta is handmade, it is chewy and has a nice texture.
Truffle pasta is fragrant and very delicious.

As mentioned in other reviews, the chicken tomato risotto is also delicious!
It looks stylish and has a large piece of chicken on top of tomato risotto, making it very filling.
It's a little sour and not too spicy, it's spicy and delicious!

It was a really satisfying shop! Thank you for the meal!

Have dinner with friends
I don’t know why the most impressive thing was the pudding and the Sands meal ordered by other people at the table🤣
The smell still lingers in the nose.
Will visit again next time 🥰

reviews.text:
It was a great experience!
The food was fabulous, some traditional and authentic, some new and surprising.
I enjoyed everything.
Service was great.
There were a lot of choices for food and wine.
They also offer a lot of homemade packages to prepare at home.
The pasta and risotto are recommended.  All the ingredients were fresh and seafood is superb.
The chef was friendly.
Wish hours were longer so we didn’t have to leave

Cozy atmosphere and magnificent environment. The portion of brunch was big and it was pretty awesome! Love truffle egg salad croissant sandwich! Cinnamon roll and pour over coffee were decent. Reasonable price and friendly service. Oh, remember you can only order brunch before 11a.m.

One of my favorite place in Taichung. Recommend to anyone likes creative Taiwan Italian fusion food with mostly local farm products.

Their sesame oil chicken Risotto is what you must to try! It sounds irrelevant, but somehow match perfectly. The chicken thigh is really crispy outside and tender inside.

If you prefer seafood (and not in your first date), Seafood & squid ink risotto is amazing! They use all fresh and local ingredients for the dish. Can taste the ocean in you mouth XD the plate has whole fresh squid 🦑 on top. It’s totally worth the price. Highly recommended!

We often order in set, because their appetizer and daily soup comes with surprise every time! Also, should try their in house sourdough. Can bring some back by ordering at their bakery🥖( soymilk Castel bun is one of their best seller, can try it out ☺️)
Excellent food quality and taste!! One of the best Italian restaurants in Taiwan.

Nice atmosphere and good ingredients, especially the salad with the abundance of in-season fruits!
I also like the white wine& clam linguine, it's simple yet sophisticated, flavorful and fresh.

reviews.text:
This little spot is a popular one given its Michelin recognition, but it's quite worthy of its hype.

Everything here is good. But I really appreciated the simple 滷肉飯 and 豬排 the most. Their 牛肉麵 is also popular and quite tasty; it has a strong carrot flavour in its broth, which I personally didn't like, but I still appreciated how dense and flavourful the broth was. A lot of other restaurants would have slightly more watered broths.

300 NTD for thick cut beef noodle and it was worth it!!  Delicious broth and beef.

The braised pork with rice was nothing special actually.

Oh and tea in the paper cup, is it just for foreigners, cos everyone around us got ceramic cups.  Tsk Tsk Tsk.
Humble shop but superb service and food. The waitress was very kind and helpful despite the crowd. Food is great and delicious

Very kind and friendly. They asked if I like to have a top-up of the sauces. The staff made me feel welcome as a guest. My two yummy dishes cost less than 100 TWD. I like this shop very much and wish them the best success.

The shrimp wonton soup is excellent, with a light broth and spinach. One of my favorites

The braised pork rice is also amazing. You can tell this place puts a lot of care into the quality of the ingredients and the prep.

The beef noodle soup wasn't my personal style, but I can still appreciate how high quality it was.

The prices are suuupper reasonable, almost too cheap. I would pay more than double the menu price

Not a ton of seating but the tables turn over quickly

reviews.text: This restaurant is fantastic. I finished my previous schedule nearby and looked for good lunch restaurants. I have not expected here to be so great. The Italian noodles are delicious, and the bread and got swap are memorable. We enjoyed this experience, and we will come back next time. By the way, this restaurant has good service, and the chef is a specialty.
nice
Very friendly, menu is in English. Food is incredible and expertly prepared.
Very tasty, my family and I really joied the pasta!

The pasta is on the hard side. I ordered duck breast and white wine clams, but the taste of the pasta was not that far off... I was a bit disappointed. The clams were already cold when they arrived. Each piece of duck breast is thick and tastes a bit too hard🥲 The most delicious thing is probably the bread! ! You must buy two extra portions 😻 The soup is also quite delicious, the Basque taste is more ordinary, and the one in the cafe is better.
There is a 10% service fee, and it is difficult to park motorcycles outside (all are red lines)

reviews.text: Bravo! We ordered six dishes via UberEats. The impeccable packaging (with zip ties!) made sure that the food stayed warm and delicious as it reached us. 👍 Will order again soon, and can’t wait until COVID is over for us to dine in!

The lady serving us (Rose) was extremely rude. She had a black face the moment we stepped in, and was very reluctant to respond when we asked her questions. Food was great but her attitude made our overall dining experience bad.

Was recommended by my private hire that this place was good - it didn’t disappoint! The 3.5 cups chicken, the red roasted pork, and the tofu were great! Service was good too, I myself would recommend for sure..
Small portions.
The store opened at 5 pm, creating a tranquil atmosphere. Seven orders were placed, totaling $1520. The dishes were vibrant, and the taste was delightful.

reviews.text: Environment and service are all good as 10% of service fee is included in the total bill if dining in. The foods are great depending on the dishes. To me, the bun, the egg tart, the fried tofu skin and fried spring roll are very good, while the dumplings are so so. However, the best point is most of the dumplings' filling are shrimp and squid so it's acceptable to be pricey. Highly recommend to try the combo as you can try more dishes.

I ordered 4 dim sum. The most disappointed is the prawn dumplings. The tastes is far different from the one I had in Hong Kong. Not sure whether they use the same recipe.

Other dishes ordered, chicken mushroom steamed rice, shrimp rice roll, baked bbq pork bun. The tastes were in above average in Taiwan.

The dining area is clean and tidy. All the dishes are made after ordering. Freshly made is a plus.

"I encountered an older staff member whose attitude was quite blunt. Is it because of my simple attire, or maybe they’re just not used to the hospitality industry, despite having been in a management role before? I've been to 添好運 in Tokyo , Shanghai, Hong Kong, and Australia, but this is the first time I’ve come across such a chilly attitude."
Great customer service and the food is good.
Good!

plus_code.compound_code: 4MQ7+J2 Taiwan, 台中市西區吉龍里

reviews.text: Amazing food! I had some of the traditional Paiwan bbq (pork) and it was finger licking. The staff is super friendly. The music is really enjoyable (some great singers performed live). Also, I happened to leave my credit card there, but the staff went out of their way messaging me and making sure I get it back. So much love for this place!

Really authentic and yummy food! There is a minimum spend per pax (I think around NTD620?) but the set meal is worth it and scrumptious!

After cooking ~9 dishes single-handedly, the chef became the live musician and that was the most impressive thing I've ever seen at a restaurant. Great atmosphere. Wonderful experience.

Really enjoyed this little gem of native Taiwanese cuisine tucked away in a little street in Taichung (1 Michelin Star!). Favourite dishes are fried tofu and the pork belly on stone. Fresh ingredients and beautifully presented. One of the staff doubles up as the piano player as well. Reservations needed as there is limited seating.

I had the set dinner and the dishes were all delicious, and could feel the sincerity of the chef in preparing the food. The singer for the night had nice voice, sounds like 张学友 but with R&B style. Enjoyed the food and songs. Highly recommended!

I would say some of the reviews on Google are not entirely objective. The comment about the portion size is not true. That caused our misjudgement when ordering (and subsequently ordering too much). It's definitely not a small portion (not like Spanish Tapas).

Most of the food items were good. I particularly like the Golden Tofu (cooked with salted egg yolks) and the ginger-flower dumplings. These are dishes you don't get every where. As for the barbecue pork, it's a bit underwhelming. The price was a bit high compared to the quality of food and price of food in the surrounding area but still reasonable.

As for the atmosphere, we didn't make a reservation beforehand so we were arranged to sit on the 2nd floor. It was very dark and the air con wasn't strong enough. I also got a few mosquito bites in the resto. Can be better.

Gulu Gulu Music Dining Room.vicinity: No. 2號, 五權西四街13巷, West District

plus_code.compound_code: 4JVP+3W Taiwan, 台中市南屯區永定里

reviews.text:
Variety and delicious food.
I recommend deep fried BBQ pork, chopped pork belly rice, and duck blood soup. Chopped pork belly rice, here is not too salt and sweet to eat, and they used the pork belly part to cook so it is not too dry and very tasty for me.

The duck’s blood soup isn’t spicy as its look, even if it’s red in color but its taste mild, and not make your tongue numbing but you may sweating.

台客燒肉粥 is a Michelin bib restaurant in Taizhong. Michelin bib is an affordable range of great food.

They serve authentic Taiwanese cuisine. Their food is worth the visit. You must try the pork and sausage! Other food such as omelette and porridge is excellent also.

reviews.text:
Very, very long queue—we waited 1 hour and 45 minutes! I was starving by the time we got in.

The restaurant layout felt a bit odd—narrow and cramped, making it difficult for the staff to move around. Everything here comes in large portions, with big trays and big plates, so each table needs an extra side table just to hold the meat and vegetables. At the same time, the staff have to push around huge carts, and there’s barely enough space for them to pass through. The whole atmosphere felt chaotic and a bit suffocating rather than impressive.

Now, onto the food—oh wow!
We ordered 鴛鴦鍋 (Yin Yang Hotpot) with 豆腐白湯鍋 (Tofu White Broth) + 無老辣香鍋 (Spicy Mala Broth), and both were incredibly rich and flavorful in their own way. The tofu was so good it left me speechless—you can keep refilling the regular tofu and duck blood, but the real highlight was their 冰淇淋豆腐鍋 (Creamy Tofu).

This creamy tofu was mind-blowing. The texture was so unique—smooth and rich like cream cheese, but not sticky or heavy. It stayed creamy even after being boiled in the hotpot, without turning watery. It was so indulgent and packed with umami, I couldn’t believe tofu like this even existed!

The beef and pork were top-tier quality, but the portions were massive—with just two of us, we could only manage one plate of each. The veggies were fresh, but honestly, the real stars here were the tofu and the broths.

I’ve never had hotpot in Taipei with flavors this bold and intense—absolutely perfect for anyone who loves strong and rich flavors.

The place has a a nice setting into it. Apparently this brand is a very famous hotpot chains and this location is their main branch. The service here is exceptional and all the servicing staff are very attentive.
I really enjoy their milk base soup and their specialty dish “ice cream tofu”. All the ingredients they serve are of good quality. If you are a hotpot lover, you definitely should check this place out. Dont forget to make reservations!!!

Pricy menu.

The multi-course menu includes a non-alcoholic sparkling grape juice served upon seating, followed by freshly baked warm bread and butter, choice of salad, soup, plum juice palette cleanser, main course, dessert, and choice of beverage.

For the main course, we ordered the 1790 NT french lambchop with prawn and the 1990 NT black angus ribeye steak (12 oz). The lambchop was tender, flavored well, and delicious, but the portion size was relatively small (3 lambchops). It was served on a bed of mashed potatoes and gravy, which paired well with the meat. Despite the smaller portion size, this was definitely the highlight of the meal.

The ribeye steak (ordered to medium doneness) was served with roasted shallots, onions, and baby corn. The portion size was huge and quite difficult for one person to finish. Though the beef quality seemed excellent, it was not as tender or flavorful as we expected, and we would probably not order this again.

The ambiance and service of the restaurant were great. The courses were brought out at a very reasonable pace - there were no long waits between courses, but the pace did not seem rushed as well. Servers were attentive.

I read the reviews on Google so I thought I give this restaurant a try. When I arrived I was told I had 3 options the $1000 NT, $1200 NT, and the $1500. I was perplexed. I saw the pictures on Google Reviews so I asked what was in the 3 options. The hostess said it would be determined by the chef. Yes, it is one of those restaurants that charges you money for dinner and then serves dishes they want to serve you. The hostess would not tell me what were the dishes in the option I chose. The options were surprises that I would not have ordered. The dishes were not outstanding, but they were different. What I did not like was the crab. It was a little Asian crab. In the US we have larger (normal size) crabs. In the US there is enough crab meat for you to get a taste and be satisfied. The cook did a good job cooking the tiny Asian crab. The crab was fried in a light sprinkling of flour and sautéed in a flavorful sauce. The crab had no meat. There was one large claw. Once you maneuvered the shell away you got a descent amount of crab meat from that one large fiddler-like crab claw. The rest of crab had flakes of meat. The sauce was great but you can't taste the crab meat. I love crab. I had eaten these tiny Asian crabs before. It was disappointing then and it was disappointing at this restaurant. The orange roe in the crab had an intense flavor, so I did enjoy the roe. Even though there was very little roe. Lastly the desert was made from something I did not like. I tried to eat it but I gave up. I had a similar experience in Norway. At least in Norway I got to choose the dishes. Here I spent $1500 NT and I was not allowed to choose my dishes. Sort of like communism. You are told by the Politburo what you should like. What you actually like does not matter.
Good experience of omakase.. something different from what we usually having.. everyone enjoy the dinner. The waiters and waitress are friendly, the service is fast. Overall our tummy is super happy!

reviews.text:
Personally, I think this restaurant has a great atmosphere with its industrial-style decor. I particularly enjoyed the paintings featuring food and the warm glow of the dim yellow lighting. However, the food tastes average, and I don’t believe it is worth the price.

Tuna with Bread ★★★★★
The bread was perfectly toasted, releasing a delightful aroma that enhanced the eating experience. The tuna sauce, made with both tuna paste and raw tuna, paired wonderfully with the bread.

Grilled Oysters ★★★★★
This was the best appetizer we ordered. Each oyster costs only 65 NT dollars, yet they were fresh and paired perfectly with the cheese.

Seafood Pasta ★
Although it included a variety of fresh seafood like shrimp, clams, and scallops, the linguine was hard, and the flavors didn’t complement the seafood.

Warm Roasted Duck Breast ★
This dish was difficult to chew, because it had many sinews. The waiter explained that they intentionally chose a part with more sinews, but perhaps they should remove them to make the price of this meal more reasonable.

Coconut Milk Latte ★
The flavor of this beverage was a bit off—too bitter and too sweet. The sugar didn’t mask the bitterness of the coffee; instead, it seemed to make it even stronger.

Pineapple Cake ★
This dessert looked delicate, but the best part was the crispy cookie on top. The cake itself tasted average and lacked creativity in its flavor and shape.

Overall, I wanted to love this place, but there were a few issues that really impacted my experience. Be warned that your favorite dishes might not be available, not even seasonal offerings that could be sold out quickly.

The biggest problem was the incredibly slow service. It took over half an hour just to receive our salads after ordering! We had to repeatedly ask for our drinks.

Wine variety wasn’t much as thought, though by the glass quality wasn’t bad.

The QR code ordering system needs a serious upgrade. Its outdated design and lack of user-friendliness don’t help our already understaffed team. In fact, it adds to their workload.

The overall dining experience was frustrating and fell short of expectations.

檸檬冬瓜很出乎意料的好喝。食物也很棒，從前菜到甜點都有讓人驚艷的亮點，補足了從點菜系統到服務流程的諸多奇怪體驗。

[Good Food and Beverage, awkward and stammered service and terrible ordering system]

Gourd lemon is surprisingly refreshing, food is great too, from appetizer to dessert gave me a WOW. It covers the flaws from robotic service and bizarre sequence of serving: first guest arrive on-time, request if we could swap to a bigger table, the staff said yes at first, after changing to the other table, staff said bigger table is reserved. But til the end of day, no guests occupying that reserved table.

When late coming guest arrived, even though they have been notified the table number and location, staff insists holding them tick the reservation full name and give some minor reminders.

Ordering system is utterly user-unfriendly. Some items gone from the order received by kitchen. Changing quantity of drinks also very hectic and came out wrongly. Therefore we have to place the other order manually, at the end it came out 2 different size of same drink with same price.

Serving sequence is irregular: pasta came prior to appetizer, then the drinks, other appetizer, followed by other entree, then the other long wait for risotto.

Generally staff are friendly and refill water frequently, that’s why even though the overall customer experience is odd, still appreciated.

Nice place, good food and a comfortable atmosphere.
The service is friendly and good, however we’ve had to wait for more than an hour to get our food served and after about 45min we’ve been told that some of the ordered dishes were out.
Yes, they did try to compensate us with free desert and in between served salads as apology.

Therefore I had to give 3 stars for the service.
Yes, they’ve handled the situation well, but could manage it better by planning ahead with available portions. As the entire order has to be done online via QR code. So, such things can be planned and no over ordering can occur.

25 minutes to wait, nobody to help us or take our order.
It's a shame because the place seems to be cosy, and the menu is interesting.
We left without having consumed anything

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

It was an extraordinary experience from start to finish. All the dishes were absolutely amazing, showcasing creativity and exquisite flavors. The presentation was impeccable, making each course a delight for both the eyes and the palate.

Chef Marc and the staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, adding to the overall exceptional dining experience. Their recommendations were spot-on, and they made sure we felt welcomed and well-cared for throughout our meal.

Such a true gem in fine dining, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable culinary adventure. I'll definitely be returning! ❤️‍🔥

The restaurant's aesthetic revolves around black tones and an industrial cement style. It features two floors, with the first floor offering a long bar seating area for a close-up view of the chef, while the second floor is divided into three sections, providing a more intimate setting.

Opting for two set menus, each boasting ten courses that vary with ingredients and seasons, our culinary journey included appetizers, mains, soups, and desserts. Every dish was a visual and flavorful delight. Noteworthy were the Bonito, Duck, and Venison – the chef skillfully presented the ingredients and sauces, resulting in robust yet perfectly balanced flavors.

As a French-Taiwanese fusion establishment, the chef transforms Taiwanese ingredients into a French culinary experience, offering a unique twist on traditional Taiwanese cuisine. Given its limited seating and reservation-only policy, it's advisable to plan well in advance—often requiring reservations over a month ahead. Anticipating a Michelin star in the future, I eagerly look forward to revisiting this exceptional dining experience.

Marc L3 is a slow food gem in Kaohsiung. The restaurant offers a different 10-course menu every day. All the dishes tasted amazing and looked perfect. The chef really mastered textures, making every single bite a delightful surprise. Also, the staff and intimate atmosphere added so much to the experience. Can't wait to return!

My partner and I had a wonderful dining experience at Marc L3. Ontop of the food being amazing, Chef Marc and his team were so friendly and made this one of our most memorable dining experiences. If you are in Kaohsiung, Marc L3 is a must visit! We hope to come back again one day.

A special shoutout to Hank for his excellent service. We truly appreciate your effort and kindness!

This is an original French cuisine with Taiwanese art. The chef's seasonal menu is like a symphony. The cleverly arranged movements are accurately reflected in the mouth. Various tastes are intertwined, and the dining environment is full of Taiwanese style.  The only disadvantage is that it is difficult to book, I hope everyone can experience different feelings smoothly.

A group of our friends had dinner at Boji Canteen on the evening of January 10, 2025. I must say that the food was delicious but the service attitude was as bad as the reviews. The point is that four of the seven of us started to come in one after another from Saturday to Monday. After experiencing stomachache, vomiting and diarrhea, each of them went to the doctor. The doctor said that if there are three people suffering from the disease in a group, it is likely to be food poisoning.

Today on January 16, 2025, I shared with my cousin that we may have food poisoning caused by Bo Kee Canteen. He recalled that nine of their family members celebrated Father’s Day together on August 7, 2024. The food in this restaurant was delicious but not delicious. On the night of the surgery, he developed stomach pain, vomited and cramped and was unable to move on his own. He had to rely on his family to move him to the emergency room for medical treatment. At the same time, two family members also experienced vomiting, diarrhea, and fever and sought medical treatment. However, they did not report it to the health bureau at the time, even though they were separated from each other. In five months, a similar situation has occurred. It is very scary. We don’t know where the ingredients in the restaurant went wrong. We will not patronize this store again.

reviews.text:
To celebrate my friends birthday, we went to Thomas Chien Restaurant for dinner. The food are super tasty and beautiful; and I loved the decoration which is elegant and peaceful. Must come back for lunch and dinner next time.
Reminder: menu changes on Mar, Jun, Sept, Dec. 😍

Thomas knows how to make impressive dishes. He uses a lot of sustainable concepts to orchestrate the dishes. Overall tasty. Fish and veggies are fine. Beef is well prepared. They can work on service to bring the place to a whole different level.

My friend recommended me Thomas Chien, even I've heard a lot about it since I moved in this city. I went there today to celebrate my partner’s birthday and we do enjoy it very much!

The food was delicious and all tastes very fresh, besides our main dish, we were especially amazed by three entrees. The staffs were very careful and professional The environment is cozy, and you can tell that the experience is carefully designed.

We are happy to bring mom there coz it was her first time to discover French cuisine (à la Taïwanais), and she was very happy about it.

##The dining time was five years ago, and the review is for reference only##

Thomas Chien is a top-notch French restaurant in Kaohsiung, known for its excellent food, service, and atmosphere. The appetizers were rich and delicate, and the chef's fusion of French and Taiwanese flavors was impressive. The desserts and tea set were satisfying, and the service from staff and cook was exceptional. Overall, the lobster was tender and flavorful, and the shrimp with white wine and caviar sauce was a beautiful and tasty dish. The bread was also noteworthy. In short, if you're in Kaohsiung and looking for an outstanding French meal, Thomas Chien is definitely worth a visit. With every bite, you can taste the chefs' passion for cooking.

The staff are friendly and professional, all the dishes are great and out of expectation, wine list with large range of variety, we have chosen a burgundy red that especially match with the beef course.

reviews.text:
It is an amazing gourmet food journey we had here at our last night in Kaosiung.

The chef is smart, talent in food fusion, and creative that I should highlight that he is willing to try new things - one of the dishes is the soup with mix of thyme rosemary and one more herb..I totally forgot it now as I was a little bit drunk 😆… indeed the wine pairing is excellent to us as well.

We hope to visit Nibbon again for another impressive journey.

Upon stepping into Nibbon Restaurant in Kaohsiung, you immediately notice the meticulous attention to detail that embodies both professionalism and finesse.

The food itself is akin to a performance art or a narrative. Each dish ingeniously blends characteristics of Japanese and French cuisines, offering not only a culinary delight but also a visual feast. The porcelainware is equally exquisite, each piece carefully curated as though an art object meant to adorn the beautiful space.

What's even more commendable is Nibbon's ever-changing seasonal menu. This not only showcases the chef's creativity and skill but also ensures that every visit offers a new surprise. Be it appetizers, main courses, or desserts, each item is thoughtfully designed and perfectly matched.

For me, this restaurant is well worth the trip from Taipei to Kaohsiung. Each visit feels like an ultimate sensory journey—from the visuals to the taste, and from the ambiance to the service, everything is just impeccable.

Nibbon is more than just a restaurant; it's a sanctuary where one can immerse themselves in both fine dining and art. If you, like me, have a passion for gourmet food and a refined lifestyle, don't miss this multifaceted restaurant located in Kaohsiung. I can guarantee it will satiate both your taste buds and soul.

Fantastic food and wine pairing. The space felt homey and warm which I always appreciate. The staff was friendly and welcoming and the service was great overall. Very rare for me to be thinking of visiting again before the meal is even over but this place left me wanting more. The food was just so beautifully executed with a lot of complexity. Would 100% come back again.

Found this on our second night of Kaohsiung. It was a 5 minute walk from our hotel. Our eating times are still off having just landed, so we were glad to find a place that opened late. We came in around 10:30pm and the server gave us an English menu. It’s a very warm and inviting interior to me. It wasn’t crowded which made it comfortable for us. You can sit on one of two sides. You face the counter on one side and on the other, you’re facing a wall but the wall had the story of how this restaurant came to be. In big font, it said “Mom’s Flavor”.

Our order was the 899NTD combo which came with your choice of soup, chicken dish, appetizer, rice or handmade noodle, drink and dessert. It also came with cold tofu, Japanese style cod liver, and an abalone salad with this amazing crispy cracker.

My boyfriend and I exchanged looks of awe and simultaneous quiet “mmmms” for each dish we ate and the soup we drank. We aren’t Taiwanese but the flavors definitely reminded us of a cozy and warm home cooked meal. Like we were being fed and taken care of by a parent’s loving cooking. The soup was so clear tasting, as in not too salty and didn’t leave some kind of flavoring aftertaste on your tastebuds. I know it’s only day 2, but this has become the favorite meal we have had so far. I told my boyfriend that I’m going to be sad once we leave the restaurant because we won’t be able to get this again at home. Am grateful to experience this.

If you need something good and tasty to nourish yourself, I highly recommend this place. Limited interaction with our server but he was warm and kind. :)

reviews.text: At the front, there is a serene and unassuming coffee shop, but upon ascending the stairs, one discovers a concealed and intimate trattoria, boasting an extensive array of delectable Italian delicacies.

Looking for a venue where you can enjoy good food and chat with friends in Kaohsiung?

Look no further, Newly is the ONE! Chef Henry pours his time, efforts and heart in making every dish to ensure everyone in the restaurant has a good time.

I highly recommend Newly if you happen to travel to Kaohsiung or wanna go somewhere eating light food with friends and family.
Only a few vegetarian options, but the food was excellent and the service was outstanding. It's best to call in advance to make sure they can accommodate your requirements.
I have eaten in Italian restaurants in Rome, London and New York and found the food quality and value at Newly right up there with the very best of them. Highly recommend!

It's a very nice shop. Come and sit for a while during afternoon tea time. It feels relaxing. The service is also good. It's worth recommending. There are a few minor flaws.
1. Lava Chocolate Cake: Not heated enough, the lava didn’t flow, but the ice cream was great
2. Shengnuo Black Puffs: The small puffs are not wrapped with icing, but are made into mushroom-shaped icing!
The above shortcomings do not hide the advantages!
This store is highly recommended!

reviews.text:
This is a Green Dinning Restaurant. All the ingredients came from Taiwan.
My son is highly recommended so that I can try it.
Various flavor dishes were giving me a surprise.
The dinner time is around two hours.
Must make an advance booking.

We were looking for a restaurant for a dinner party with friends. They are all people who love to eat and cook. They all thought the meal was very surprising and a very enjoyable meal!

The environment is very relaxed and comfortable, and the boss and his wife are very attentive to our dining experience and feedback. Not only are the dishes well-designed, but every corner is full of stories (I heard that the boss decorated and painted it himself), and it has a full ocean feel (even the toilet has the sound of waves crashing). Before the meal, Natsu placed the small-scale farmers' ingredients for today's meal on the main visual table (a long curved table that symbolizes time). Every bite that follows is the taste of the products at this moment.

The dessert of the day was "Gunzan". Natsu's attempt to put the mountain scenery of his hometown Hatakeyama into a glass made people feel heart-warming.
The dense smoke is lingering in the cup. Use a spoon to break the crispy chips covering the cup. The smoke will rise from the Yamagata matcha ice cream in the cup (for Xiaolu to eat). It temporarily evokes the memory of everyone using acacia and longan wood as firewood in Asayama.
Beetroot jelly, chestnuts, cocoa and bananas ask us to imagine the scene from the national highway to Qishan. This is the feeling when driving into Qishan in the early morning in winter
The content of the menu is based on the seasons of small farmers, the weather of the day, the mood of the chef, and who the diners are. It is so surprising and impromptu. Pastry chef Siyo is the best catcher. He receives the design of each dish in time and conveys it to everyone at the meal.

I really enjoy knowing what I'm eating, it's very satisfying! You can talk freely, you can listen well when you calm down, eat well, fall in love with a certain dish, and get to know a group of people who take the ingredients seriously

This visit to this restaurant and restaurant was truly an unforgettable experience. From the chef to the service staff, everyone was very kind and explained the concept of the restaurant to us carefully. They are committed to supporting local industries in Taiwan, using organic crops and humanely raised animal ingredients, and taking environmental friendliness as their core value. Each dish is not only delicious, but also conveys the chef's respect for the ingredients and love for the land.

The creativity and level of the meals are amazing. Each dish has its own soul. Even the names of the dishes are full of poetry and ingenuity:

1. Fresh: This appetizer kicks off the meal with a fresh flavor, like a gentle breeze, injecting the first surprise into the taste buds.

2. Acid: The acidity is just right, bringing an invigorating refreshing feeling that is balanced and harmonious.

3. Nature: Show creativity with the concept of "egg lays chicken, chicken lays egg", which perfectly interprets the cycle and purity of life.

4. Natural: Emphasis on the authentic taste of the ingredients, simple yet full of layers, making people feel the purest side of the ingredients.

5. Black: Taking the black pig as the protagonist, it is presented with charcoal grilling. The rich charcoal aroma and the sweetness of the pork are perfectly combined, which is endless aftertaste.

6. RFI: This dish represents an international certification standard, which makes people taste not only the delicious taste, but also the commitment and trust in the source of the ingredients.

7. Rhizome: Inspired by the essence of the earth, it showcases the natural aroma and rich taste of rhizomes.

8. Spices: Various spices are used to create exotic flavors, and every bite is like an adventure into the unknown.

9. Mountains: As the finale dessert, it seems to take us into the quiet mountains, and the natural sweetness is the perfect ending to the entire meal.

Each dish is like telling a story, telling the chef's philosophy and love for the land through taste. And my favorite is the last dessert "Gunshan". It is not only a pleasure for the taste buds, but also a journey of the soul, taking us back to the embrace of nature and feeling pure and profound. This dining experience is undoubtedly a feast that combines art, emotion and delicious food, making people look forward to visiting again.

The ingredients are seasonal, organic, environmentally friendly, and animal welfare. The meals are very exquisite and you can taste the original and sweet taste of the food. The source of the ingredients will be carefully explained in each dish. Highly recommended❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

We are Hong Kong people traveling to Kaohsiung. We appreciate the principle of using local ingredients here. From appetizers to desserts, they are all very exciting. One of us chose the "Forest" vegetarian theme, and the other chose the "Mountain" meat theme. The menu-less experience is recommended for everyone to try it for yourself!

reviews.text: This Shabu is worth of money. Soup is delicious and good quality of meats. Dumplings are delicious. But I don’t like sauce, it’s too thicken. I found that very long queue thus I avoided it to reach there around 4 p.m.

Our tour guide recommended we try sacha hotpot which is a Taiwanese specialty sauce. He made us reservations which is a good thing because this place was packed and people were waiting outside for a table on a Friday night. There are other locations but this is the main/original one. There are 2 floors and almost every table was full at 6 pm.

We picked the double hotpot broths- Mala spicy and herbal on the other side. The mala broth was pretty spicy. Your mouth gets numb and your nose starts running but it is super tasty. The herbal wine broth was a little odd at first but it grows on you, especially after adding garlic, onions and scallions. There are tons of herbs. Mixing the 2 broths was the best. We got 3 different cuts of meat and my favorite was the ribeye. We also got fried tofu skin, mushrooms, corn, and bok choy and they gave us cabbage and tofu too. The veggies were really good. I didn’t care for the sacha sauce but my friends liked it. We also got some udon.

For 3 people the meal came out to about $23 per person, which is super cheap by American standards, but considered expensive/fancy in Taiwan. Definitely recommend this place for local good hotpot. Bonus- they accept cards which almost none of the restaurants we went to did.

Close to Fomosa MRT, long history hotpot, very crowded with long queue during Lunar New Year, waiting time is about 15-20mins.

Price is not cheap but worth to try

One of my favorite hotpot places. Been open for years and years and years. Their sour cabbage stock was amazing. wide variety of choice of meats and seafood. everything was so fresh. definitely a recommend.

Food is amazing and the beef is really tender.

The service is impeccable with good suggestions.

reviews.text:
Amazed at how efficient this place is.

The food quality is also good, and being able to make beef wellington at the correct doneness and still ensuring the beef is tender and juicy deserves kudos to the team. This dish is not easy to get right, and some upscale restaurants don't even get them right.

The food portion is very generous, and the floor manager does come around to ask if you need more bread.

A palatte cleanser was even served before the main.

Totally overrated.
Food came with so much delay that the kids were done and no one had received their food yet. Yet again, the last meal, a flank steak, cannot understand the ridiculous delay for that one.
As we were waiting to pay, they were rudely yelling to wait outside. Wtf.

Then, the elevator door hit my wife…

Got a recommendation from someone who said it was good in the past… clearly not anymore.

At some point, my wife had to ask someone to clean the table a bit because it was a mess.

The dining experience at this restaurant had its ups and downs. First of all, the drinks are not recommended. Tried two different ones, but neither was satisfying. Surprisingly, the complimentary slushie was much better, with a perfectly balanced sweet and sour taste that was refreshing and helped cleanse the palate. The medium-rare steak had a great texture and was very flavorful. The duck breast had a crispy exterior, with firm and delicious meat.

In addition, the staff were very attentive and kindly reminded us about the birthday month promotion, which enhanced the overall dining experience. The food quality was good, but the drinks could use some improvement.

A decent set menu, planned carefully. Nice atmosphere and good service.
Food is excellent.

Came here for a special event and was really impressed with the service and how quickly the food came . This restaurant is located on the second floor. They have a set menu where you can select your soups, salads, meats, dessert and drinks. You can also upgrade your portions for the meats. The presentation of the platters where great and the portions felt just about right. You need to make a reservation for larger groups but not sure if they except walk ins. I have two issues, first is I feel the servers are a bit confused when serving your order. Maybe because we’re a large group? But peoples soup where missing or the served the wrong cooked meat. My other issue is their lack of parking, which isn’t their fault but there really isn’t any or enough. We need to park by the other side of the block. Other than that I would recommend you stop by and give them a try.

This restaurent is very nicely decorated with the idea of nostalgic Taiwan.
Everything in here is Taiwan back in time.
loved every bit and I just had to take pictures of everything.
the food is also very good.
the service is also good and fast.
I loved the soup.
there were 2 dishes I didn't like like the veggies and the pork.
overall would come again to try different dish.

We were visiting the children's art museum and then we walked to this restaurant. Minimum charge is 300 per adult and 150 per child. We got the set meal for 2 (not available on holidays). We were there on a weekday night at 5pm and we walked right in without a reservation. The food is as mentioned, very tasty. It's like elevated home cooked meal. Old timey taste. The soups were huge and we couldn't finish all the food. They had high chairs available and the service was prompt and helpful. There's a train you can fine in (but it was very hot when we were there) so we dined in the normal dining room. Cash only, nice for a visit for a blast from the past.
Very fun place to visit and dine in. The restaurant will bring you back to Taiwan in 1960s. The food was good and they welcome you walking around and taking photos.

Great place for families, so you can try their many interesting dishes. The shrimp with scallions and salted duck egg yolk was flavorful. First time trying stir-fried white water snowflake with pickled cordia fruit (破布子炒水蓮), so yummy!  Would recommend the pork with pickled vegetables, the crispy chicken with (real) plum sauce, and the silver fish omelette. Everything was very authentic and delicately cooked. Add the pork fat rice to
make an extremely satisfying meal. The museum with the antiques and the train was a hit for young and old.

fun indoor decoration with real train car used as part of restaurant, decoration indoors with 30s Taiwan historical artifacts showcasing past daily life. Recently brought two Japanese friend to introduce authentic Taiwanese cuisine, and has range to select from. Best come with person with basic knowledge in Taiwan dishes.

reviews.text: Came around 7pm and there was along queue but it went by very quickly. They have a small menu so it’s easy to choose from. The portions are big and everything came quickly. They have spice and garlic sauces at every table. Highly recommend if you’re in the area. Cash only.

Long queue truly worths.

The soup of beef noodles and pork knuckle noodles taste different, but both are great.

The beef & the pork knuckle are tender. Adding chopped garlic & chilli enhances the flavor of the soup to the max level of deliciousness.

This shop is highly recommended.

I like both their dry tossed pork knuckle noodle and beef broth noodle. Especially the dry noodle, I was impressed by how even aft I left it there like 10 min yet it didn't clump up. The sauce was flavorful yet not oily nor overpowering. The beef broth noodle was equally good though the broth had clean yet flavorful taste. But might be a tad light for some people. Beef tender and a mixture of some tendon and brisket. Noodles springy and beef tendon too had a nice bite, not too tough nor soft, cooked just right. Staff were obviously family like and cordial and polite. Place also decently clean(I sat next to toilet yet no foul smell) But I think a little pricey though. Portion of noodles were generous though.

This was one of the best beef noodles I have ever had. A must visit if you are in the area. The dry noodles had a richer flavor than the soup ones so I recommend the dry. Everything was good but could use some better hot sauce chilli oil options. Quick service. Not much English but made it work. Check this place out for sure!

I recommend it to those who like thick meat and noodles. The service is not good because it is a restaurant with many customers.
The staff is too busy. I don't recommend going to crowded weekends or mealtimes. Delicious soup and meat give you satisfaction.
I hope you can stop by when you go to the Bore Arts Special Zone or Chichin Island.
